title: Concentration and Calibration in Predictive Bayesian Inference
summary: Predictive Bayesian inference (PBI) represents a model-and prior-agnostic approach to standard Bayesian inference which allows users to quantify uncertainty for a functional of interest only by specifying a forward predictive model for future unobserved data. The flexibility and generality of this framework have led to a host of novel algorithms for implementing this approach, and many empirical applications, yet the reliability of the resulting inferences for the underlying statistical functional of interest remains unclear.
